iti46:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti46:2.1: “Monks, live with the trainings [in heightened virtue, heightened mind, & heightened discernment] as your reward, with discernment uppermost, release the essence, & mindfulness the governing principle. As you live with the trainings as your reward, with discernment uppermost, release the essence, & mindfulness the governing principle,
iti46:2.2: then one of two fruits can be expected:
iti46:2.3: either gnosis right in the here-&-now, or–if there be any remnant of clinging-sustenance–non-return.”
iti46:3.1:
Complete in the training,
not subject to falling away,
iti46:3.2:
one with discernment
uppermost,
seeing the stopping, the ending of birth:
iti46:3.3:
that sage
bears his last body,
iti46:3.4:
has shaken off Māra, I tell you,
has gone beyond aging.
iti46:4.1:
So, always
delighting in jhāna,
centered,
iti46:4.2:
ardent,
seeing the stopping, the ending of birth,
iti46:4.3:
conquering Māra, along with his armies,
monks,
